name: Sodium diethylenetriamine pentamethylene phosphonate
description: Sodium diethylenetriamine pentamethylene phosphonate ( CAS 22042-96-2 ), commercially known as Dequest 2066, is a high-performance phosphonate chelating agent used across water treatment and industrial process applications. It controls scale formation and inhibits corrosion in systems where conventional phosphonates underperform, particularly under high-temperature or high-hardness conditions. In industrial water treatment, it prevents calcium carbonate scale. The chemical also prevents calcium sulfate and barium sulfate scale in cooling towers, boilers, and reverse osmosis systems. Oilfield operators use it in injection water and produced water circuits to suppress mineral deposition. This product protects downhole equipment and ensures efficient flow. Textile and leather processors apply it to sequester hardness ions in process baths, improving dye uptake consistency and preventing metal-induced fabric damage. In pulp and paper production, it stabilizes peroxide bleaching baths by deactivating trace metal ions that would otherwise decompose the bleach prematurely. This ensures maximum efficiency during the bleaching process. Sodium diethylenetriamine pentamethylene phosphonate is supplied as an aqueous solution, typically at concentrations around 20–30% active content. It is available in technical grade suitable for industrial formulation. Bulk supply is standard in IBC containers and drummed quantities for smaller-volume buyers. This ensures reliable logistics and handling for various industrial scales and specific manufacturing requirements.
